issue_context.title: Vendor `distutils.version` in `module_utils`
issue_context.body:
##### SUMMARY

`distutils` is deprecated in Python 3.10 and will be removed in 3.12. Vendor the contents of `distutils.version` to a module_util, move all internal usages to it, and document the change for collections development.

##### ISSUE TYPE

Feature Idea

##### COMPONENT NAME

ansible

review_comments:
I cannot remove this filter currently, since `packaging.tags` imports `distutils.util`.  The call order is:

`ansible.plugins.loader` -> `packaging.specifiers` -> `packaging.utils` -> `packaging.tags` -> `distutils.util`

Packaging removed use of `distutils.util` in https://github.com/pypa/packaging/commit/c8008265eac83ebf2c3b3c314a682abd4c101de2 and no release contains this change yet.

We may need to wait even longer, since there are many deps we don't control that could surface this warning in collections as well.
I was literally about to paste a link to that commit here. Jinx!

> We may need to wait even longer, since there are many deps we don't control that could surface this warning in collections as well.

I was going to look at our other deps to see if they have similar problems. Maybe we'll get lucky.
